builder.summary: Karpathy is a world-class ML systems builder with deep agent and foundation model expertise (agents 95, ml 76). He ships production-grade inference engines (nanochat, micrograd) and education tools (nn-zero-to-hero, LLM101n), but has no competition wins. His strengths lie in agentic research pipelines and low-level training code; he should target hackathons with agentic AI or ML education themes offering substantial prizes, and avoid generic beginner-friendly events with low-code requirements.
